descripcion_geo: The mountains of Seir are the mountain range east of the Arabah inhabited by the Edomites; Seír is an alternative name of Edom.
importancia_estrategica: Esau's mountainous land; place of Jehoshaphat's victory according to 2 Chronicles.

historias.titulo: The vision of Ezekiel against Mount Seir
historias.descripcion: Ezekiel prophesies against Mount Seir because he rejoiced when Israel fell; It will be desolate.

historias.titulo: Jehoshaphat: Mount Seir destroys its own allies
historias.descripcion: The invaders of Moab and Ammon attack those of Mount Seir; then they turn against each other and destroy each other.
The song of Deborah evokes the Lord who marched from the field of Edom/Seír in the past.

personajes.descripcion: He uttered a full oracle against Mount Seir for its hostility to Israel.
Their enemies on Mount Seir destroyed each other; His victory was without combat.
Their song evokes God's ancient march from Seir as an image of his power.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Mount Seir: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: God marched from Seir to save his people: the mountain of the enemy becomes the scene of divine action (Judges 5:4; Deut 33:2).
judaismo.significado_teologico: God marched from Seir to save his people: the mountain of the enemy becomes the scene of divine action (Judges 5:4; Deut 33:2).
